Known for its carefully curated library, Criterion highlights everything from timeless Hollywood films to groundbreaking international cinema, ensuring that influential directors and movements remain accessible to modern audiences. Each release often includes interviews, essays, and behind-the-scenes features that enrich the viewing experience and underline the cultural significance of the work. For cinephiles and collectors, Criterion is more than a distributor.
